mainEntity.name: Is Christopher W. Burns still wanted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. As of October 15, 2026, he is listed on the FBI Most Wanted Fraudsters page with a reward of up to $150,000.

mainEntity.name: When was Christopher W. Burns last seen?

acceptedAnswer.text: September 24, 2020, when he left his home in Georgia.
It is his FBI-listed place of birth, and public identifiers linked to him, including a Google Maps contributor profile with later activity, point to the Wayne area.
